status.description: completed/partial/blocked. Decision tree (predicates evaluated in order, first match wins) lives in harness/contracts/agent/section-status-decision.md and is normative. In particular: agentFixable=true codes from harness/contracts/preview-blocker-codes.json (missing bootstrap, missing deps, stale build, missing runtime dep, storefront not running) MUST be self-remediated by the implementing agent and are NOT legitimate `blocked` reasons.

mode.description: How the runtime screenshots were produced. storefront-render is verify-section-preview against a running Shopify theme; offline-snapshot is verify-section-preview-offline against a static preview HTML.

assetUploads.description: Assets uploaded to Shopify Files via POST /v1/sync-jobs (typically REST asset candidates from design-assets/manifest.json). Recorded so verify-section-implementation can audit upload provenance and so re-runs of page assembly can resolve setting values without re-uploading.

sourcePath.description: Repo-relative path to the source asset that was uploaded.

sha256.description: Content sha256 of the uploaded bytes. Allows verify to confirm the upload matches the REST asset candidate.

shopifyFileId.description: MediaImage GID returned by Shopify Files (e.g. gid://shopify/MediaImage/123). Null when the upload failed.

shopifyUrl.description: CDN URL returned by Shopify Files.

settingId.description: templateContribution.settings key this upload backs. Null when the upload was skipped or only retained as a candidate.

settingValue.description: Recommended templateContribution.settings value for image_picker fields. Use the literal shopify://files/<filename> form so page assembly does not have to translate between MediaImage GIDs and theme JSON references.

syncJobId.description: POST /v1/sync-jobs job id that produced the upload. Null when the upload was retained as a candidate without being run.

skippedReason.description: Set when the asset was retained as a candidate but not uploaded; for example a layered Figma fill that the implementation did not need.

openIssues.description: Free-text issues that need follow-up. When an issue maps to a stable preview-blocker code, the entry SHOULD be prefixed with the code from harness/contracts/preview-blocker-codes.json followed by ': ' — e.g. "PREVIEW_STOREFRONT_PASSWORD_REJECTED: storefront password rejected by 127.0.0.1:9292". The decision tree in harness/contracts/agent/section-status-decision.md inspects this prefix to enforce that agentFixable=true codes do not co-occur with status=blocked.

notesAcknowledged.description: Proof that the implementing agent read harness/notes/<page-key>.json before writing this result. Required by section-result-validation when a matching notes entry exists; absence is treated as either 'no notes file' (acceptable, must be recorded in openIssues) or 'agent skipped notes' (a policy violation).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the notes file the agent read.

sha256.description: Content sha256 of the notes file at read time. Validation re-hashes the on-disk file and rejects if it has drifted, so an agent cannot claim notes acknowledgement against stale content.

sectionId.description: Section id within the notes file that the agent acknowledged. Must match section-result.sectionId.

agentPrompt.description: Verbatim copy of notes.sections[*].agentPrompt for this section, mirrored to make the section-result self-contained for reviewers. Null when the notes entry has no agentPrompt.

implementationPolicy.description: Verbatim mirror of notes.sections[*].implementationPolicy. Null when the notes entry does not override implementation policy.
